preconditions.description: The starting string must be a string.
The number of iterations n must be an integer.
The number of iterations n must be greater than zero.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == look_and_say_sequence(start, n-1) if n == 1 else generate_next(look_and_say_sequence(start, n-1))
postconditions.description: The return value must be the nth element of the look and say sequence starting with the given start string.
